title: Permission matrix: each permission group's header row used scope="colgroup" with no column groups, so the header was associated with no cells, and all groups shared one row group
source: manual review of the table markup, prompted by axe needs-review th-has-data-cells
resolution: PermissionMatrixPage.tsx: one <tbody> per permission group, headed by <th scope="rowgroup">; regression test in identity-access/screens.test.tsx (fails without the fix). axe still reports th-has-data-cells as needs-review: an axe 4.13 heuristic, reviewed as conforming (report §5.2)

title: Stored narrative shown without its language: the project title on the workspace heading, and risk, issue and change-request titles and their project names in the three registers, are read in the interface's language (an English title in an Arabic voice)
source: harness language-of-parts list, reviewed by hand
resolution: lang from the record's own language (languageTag) on PageHeader (new titleLanguage prop, ProjectWorkspace), RiskTable, ConcernTable, EscalationTable and ChangeRequestTable, beside their existing dir="auto"; assertions in four component suites (fail without the fix). Untagged items on these screens: 1/16/16/16 before, 0 after

title: Report TEXT cells (e.g. the project title in the Department Project Register report) are shown without a language: the API's ReportCell carries no language, so the SPA cannot mark them
source: harness language-of-parts list, reviewed by hand
resolution: Needs an FG-02 contract change: a language on ReportCell for TEXT columns whose source is narrative, then CellValue sets lang. Not changed here (API contract and snapshot). Either build it before UAT or AHDA accepts a deferral
owner: Backend (FG-02 Reports); AHDA PMO for a deferral

title: No assistive-technology session by a person: the audit's screen-reader evidence is the browser accessibility tree (roles, names, landmarks, headings), not NVDA, JAWS or VoiceOver output heard in either locale
resolution: Run report §5.3's script with NVDA + Firefox (Windows) and VoiceOver + Safari (macOS) in both locales on the ten top-traffic screens; record each defect as its own row. Or AHDA accepts the accessibility-tree review in its place
owner: QA Lead with an AHDA accessibility representative

title: The signed-in shell exposes 14 navigation landmarks (one per sidebar section) before main: each is uniquely named, but landmark navigation with a screen reader steps through all of them
resolution: Recommendation: one <nav> for the sidebar with labelled section lists. Component tests that query a section's navigation by name move with it; a design decision for the UX owner, not a conformance defect

title: A user's job title (a directory attribute) is shown without a language on User detail: the directory records none
source: harness language-of-parts list, reviewed by hand
resolution: No change proposed: the attribute has no language to give. Revisit if AHDA's directory carries one
